name: Kawazoe Mamiko
source:
The wife of Shuuichi, and the mother of Miki. She got acquainted with Shuuichi when they were students, and eventually got married. Now they have a daughter and a son, and lives as a family of 4. 

Currently, she's a full time housewife, and looks after her newborn first son. As it appears, Mamiko prefers a son more than a daughter, so her relationship with Miki who is in a rebellious age isn't in a good state. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.lpv-gamesoft.com/mydaugther/qmd001/character.html]Official Site[/url]]
